span.p:
POST /api/asr/transcribe
video_id: string
language?: string = vi
keyframes?: KeyframeRecord[]

div.style: color: rgb(43, 43, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
KeyframeRecord
video_id: string
frame_id: string
timestamp_ms: integer >= 0
img_path: non-empty string

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Validate request
extra fields forbidden
only language = vi

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Normalize audio
FFmpeg → PCM mono 16 kHz WAV

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Attach text to keyframes
start ≤ timestamp_ms / 1000 < end

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
200 AsrResponse
video_id
language
full_transcript
segments[]
keyframes[] + text?

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
segments[]
video_id · start/end in seconds
text · confidence?

video_id · frame_id
timestamp_ms · img_path
text?

span.p:
Error responses
422 validation · language · audio · keyframe
404 MEDIA_NOT_FOUND
502 ASR_RESULT_INVALID
503 resolver · inference

asr_media_resolver
→ request via main.app returns 503

current field is timestamp_ms
keyframe.video_id is required
